typesense:popular.greeting:
***Shadowfell, a land without gods.***

*The land of Shadowfell is fraught with darkness, dangers and a grim aesthetic. It is also a land of stories, legends and dark beauty. This realm incorporates various twists on standard fantasy elements, as well as dangerous unique events to keep things interesting.*

***Compendium:***

***REGIONS:***

***The Green:** A region of lush green; forests, fields, hills, rivers. Humans and Elves inhabit this region.*
***The White:** A region of snow and cold; high mountains, frigid wastes. Dwarves inhabit this region.*
***The Black:** A region of obsidian and heat; volcanoes, black wastelands, red forests. Orcs, Dragons and Drakes inhabit this region.*
***The Grey:** A region of perpetual fog and low sunlight; swamps, caves, ruins. Tieflings, Vampires and Werewolves inhabit this region.*

***UNIQUE MONSTERS:***

***Skaven:** The Skaven are a race of vicious mutant rat-men who lurk in under-cities below civilisation. They seek to bring pestilence and ruin to the surface-dwellers, and kill or enslave all who would oppose them.*
***Daemons:** Daemons are savage, vile creatures that annihilate without prejudice. They come in many shapes and sizes; claws, teeth, wings, scales, fur. Some of them are even capable of using magic.*

***UNIQUE EVENTS:***

***Blood Moon:** On certain nights, a Blood Moon will appear in the sky. During these nights, Daemons will invade civilisation in hordes, seeking to destroy everything in sight.*
***Dragon Hunt:** Rarely, a Dragon and its Drakes from The Black will encroach other regions to wreak havoc and destruction on civilised land.*
***Skaven Invasion:** If there is a Skaven under-city beneath a city, the Skaven may emerge from below to annihilate the city above.*

*You can be whatever you wish in this land; a peasant, an adventurer, even a monster or a returned god. Now, who are you and what is the situation you find yourself in? Be as brief or detailed as you wish.*

title_i18n.hi: गहरा मध्यकालीन काल्पनिक RPG; शैडोफेल की काली, अंधेरी भूमि का अन्वेषण करें।
title_i18n.it: Gioco di ruolo fantasy medievale oscuro; attraversa la terra tetra e oscura di Shadowfell.
title_i18n.ja: 暗い中世ファンタジーRPG; 厳しく暗い土地Shadowfellを横断する。
title_i18n.ko: 암흑 중세 판타지 RPG; grim하고 어두운 Shadowfell의 땅을 횡단하세요.
title_i18n.pl: Ciemna średniowieczna fantazja RPG; przemierzaj ponury, mroczny kraj Shadowfell.

title_i18n.ru: Тёмная средневековая фэнтези-RPG; путешествуйте по мрачной, тёмной земле Шэдоуфелл.

title_i18n.zh: 黑暗中世纪幻想 RPG；穿越阴暗、黑暗的阴影国度。
